project_info.theme: dreamy adult rooftop romance with direct flash at blue hour
project_info.color_palette: cool dusk blue, pale yellow satin, black, white, and warm window light

main_subject.description: an adult woman in a pale-yellow satin midi dress with a small white shoulder bag and an adult man in a black suit with a white shirt
main_subject.pose_and_expression: the adult man gently kisses her temple while holding her at the waist; she smiles softly toward camera with one hand at his neck

composition_elements.foreground: adult couple, satin dress sheen, white bag, and metal rooftop railing
composition_elements.background: apartment rooftop, soft city buildings, warm window bokeh, and fading blue sunset gradient
composition_elements.visual_hierarchy: adult couple faces and gentle interaction, pale-yellow satin, then rooftop city glow

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: direct on-camera flash with natural falloff, balanced by blue-hour sky fill and warm window-light bokeh

technical_specs.rendering: realistic skin, clean hands and jewelry, subtle film grain, smooth flash highlight rolloff, controlled satin sheen

prompt.generated_prompt_string: A dreamy rooftop romantic snapshot of an adult couple at blue hour with direct on-camera flash. The adult woman wears a pale-yellow satin midi dress, a small white shoulder bag, and minimal jewelry; the adult man wears a black suit with a white shirt. They stand close at a metal railing. He gently kisses her temple while holding her at the waist; she smiles softly toward camera with one hand at his neck. Behind them are apartment rooftops, city buildings with warm window lights, and a dusk sky with a faint sunset gradient. Shoot an eye-level three-quarter candid portrait on a 35mm lens with sharp natural faces and hands, realistic satin, subtle film grain, flash contrast, blue-hour fill, and warm bokeh.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, explicit, nsfw, sexualized pose, nudity, blurry faces, double face, deformed hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, CGI, cartoon, harsh blown flash, heavy blur, oversharpen halos, low resolution, noise artifacts, text, logo, watermark
